sources.citation: Smith, Geoffrey P. 1988. Morobe counting systems. In Papers in New Guinea Linguistics No. 26, 1-132. Pacific Linguistics A-76. Canberra: Research School of Pacific Studies, Australian National University.

Nothing on word stress or tone in Piu.
